description.value: The CPL Poirier Branch is a single-storey civic library operated by Coquitlam Public Library, providing free access to books, digital resources, computers, and community programming. As a no-admission-required public facility in the Tri-Cities area, it offers a welcoming rest environment for touring cyclists passing through Coquitlam. The branch is fully wheelchair accessible and runs a broad range of programs for adults, teens, and children.
